instruction: In VLC preferences, set the recording folder to Desktop and also turn off the video title display on screen.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc via bash grep with anchored pattern ^(record-path|video-title-show)=, which matches the vlcrc key-value format.
Both instruction requirements are checked: (1) recording folder set to /home/user/Desktop via record-path key, (2) video title display disabled via video-title-show=0.
Metric awards 0.5 per sub-goal with correct comparisons: path equality after stripping trailing slash, and string comparison of video-title-show to '0'.
Negative control resistance is sound: initial state (no record-path set in vlcrc, video-title-show absent or defaulting to 1) yields score 0.0 since both result fields would be None.
Expected values in the task JSON match the evaluator checks: expected_record_path=/home/user/Desktop and expected_video_title_show=0.
VLC only writes settings to vlcrc when the user explicitly saves via the Preferences dialog, so the evaluator measures the actual GUI action, not the command-line launch flag --no-video-title-show.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Verify that the target Docker environment's VLC version stores the recording path under the key 'record-path' (not 'input-record-path') in vlcrc. If the key differs, the getter would return None for record_path and the recording-path check would always fail.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC, navigated to Tools > Preferences > Input/Codecs, clicked Browse to select the Desktop folder as the recording directory, then clicked Save.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC menus, open Simple Preferences dialog, switch between preference tabs, browse filesystem dialogs, select folders, toggle checkboxes, and save settings.
metadata.explanation: Compositional hardened task: agent must complete TWO goals in VLC Simple Preferences: (1) set recording path to Desktop via Input/Codecs tab, and (2) disable video title display via Video tab. Evaluator reads vlcrc and awards 0.5 per completed goal. video-title-show=0 means title is disabled (default in VLC is 1=show).
metadata.task_rationale: Composed from source trajectory capability (Input/Codecs recording path) with a compatible second objective from the Video tab in the same Preferences dialog. Both goals require navigating the Simple Preferences UI - same app, same setup, one additional tab.
